entries.origin_note: Broad plant-like life; draft historical wording foregrounds life-matter whose size changes/grows. Exact classifier belongs to the world ontology.
Broad animal-like life; historically named for self-movement.
Tree Kind; historically named as a high-size/hard member of the plant concept.
Bush/shrub Kind; historically named as a low-size member of the plant concept.
Stone/rock material Kind; historical name foregrounds hardness.
Wood material Kind; historically understood as matter from/part of trees.
Metal material family; historical name foregrounds hard matter reshaped with heat.
Blood material Kind; historical name foregrounds living liquid matter.
Bone Kind; historically named as a hard animal part.
Flesh/meat Kind; historically named as animal matter/part.
General tool Kind.
Weapon Kind; historically named as a tool for ending life.
Cutting/separating tool family; historical wording foregrounds ending joined matter.
Blade Kind; a sharp cutting-tool family.
Sword Kind; historical name treats it as a longer blade.
Hammer/striking-forming tool family.
Digging/scooping tool family; historical name foregrounds moving matter.
General container Kind; historical wording foregrounds being a thing that other things are put/kept in.
Portable container/bucket family.
Rope/binding-line family; historically named as a thing used to bring things into a joined state.
Clothing/worn covering family.
Bed/sleeping-support Kind.
House/shelter Kind; historical wording foregrounds living beings being in it.
Door/gate Kind; a part used to move through a boundary.
Wall/barrier Kind; historical name foregrounds preventing movement.
Road/route surface Kind; historical name foregrounds moving through/along it.
Bridge Kind; a historical 'movement-sides thing' name for a thing enabling movement across sides.
Boat/watercraft Kind.
Ship Kind; later vocabulary built from the already-established Boat Old Name and a high-size descriptor.
Well/water-source structure Kind.
Fire/flame phenomenon Kind; historical name foregrounds heat and light.
Food Kind; draft historical wording foregrounds life-sustaining matter passed/transferred to a living being.

Common historical transfer-of-possession verb. The Sign fossilized from Transfer + Have; its frozen event meaning is the concurrent end of the giver's Have state and beginning of the recipient's Have state. Ownership/legal transfer is not silently added.
Medicine/therapeutic matter family.
Poison/toxic matter family.

Farm/agricultural holding or cultivation-site family; historical name foregrounds causing/hosting growth of food-producing life. Current world modeling treats a Farm as a persistent agricultural Entity, with fields/buildings/workers represented separately.
Farmer/cultivator role Kind; historical name foregrounds work that changes/grows food-producing life.
Food store/granary Kind; historically a thing food is kept in.
Currency/exchange-token Kind; historical name foregrounds transfer and acquisition.
Market/trading gathering or institution; historical name foregrounds transfer and acquisition.
Settlement/village/town family; a place/thing a human group is in.
Family/kin-group family; historical name foregrounds a human life-group.
Leader/director role Kind.
Council/planning-directing group Kind.
Healer role Kind.
Teacher role Kind; historical wording foregrounds speaking information that becomes known.
Messenger/courier role Kind; historical wording foregrounds moving to deliver spoken/informational content.
Guard/protector role Kind; historical name foregrounds preventing death.
School/teaching institution Kind; historical wording foregrounds saying/communicating knowledge.
Healing institution/place Kind.
Court/tribunal institution Kind.
Word/lexical-sign Kind; historically named as a sign carrying meaning.
Language/lexical system Kind; historical name built from the earlier Word Old Name.
Persistent record/document Kind.
Book/compiled-record Kind.
Map Kind; record whose conventional content concerns a region.
Calendar Kind; persistent record organizing repeating temporal extents.
Contract/documented-obligation Kind; rebuilt from the persistent-record Old Name after Promise and CommittedTo became compositional.
Letter/written-message Kind; historical wording foregrounds a persistent sign used to say something.
Law/legal-rule Kind; historical name foregrounds obligations and permissions.
Clock/time-measurement tool family; historical name rebuilt from Extent after Duration became a derived reading.
Length-measuring tool family.
Mass/weighing tool family.
Air/atmospheric gas concept; historical name foregrounds life-supporting gaseous matter.
Fish/aquatic-animal family; historical name reuses the earlier Animal Old Name.
Fisher role; historical wording foregrounds acquiring fish.
Eye/visual organ family.
Ear/hearing organ family.
Claw/talon family; historical name foregrounds a sharp body part.
Tail family; historical name foregrounds a body part whose length is high relative to the relevant standard.
Mouth/oral opening family; historical name foregrounds eating.
Skin/body-covering tissue family; historical name foregrounds the body surface.
Corpse/dead-body concept; historical name foregrounds a body for which Life held before Now and does not hold now.
Window/opening/viewing panel family; historically a wall-part enabling vision through it.
Spoon/scooping eating-tool family; historical name foregrounds moving food with a tool.
Scent trail/path family; historical wording foregrounds a path followed through olfaction.
Sailor/ship-worker role; historical name foregrounds using a ship.
Ship crew group built from the Sailor Old Name.
Captain/ship leader role; historical name foregrounds a human controlling a crew.
Tree branch/major tree-part family.
Tree bark/surface-tissue family.
General body-organ family; historical name foregrounds a body part with a function/use.
Stomach/digestive-organ family; later anatomy vocabulary built from the earlier Organ Old Name.
Wrist/joint-region family; historical wording foregrounds the joined hand/body-part boundary after the Hand Old Name was rebuilt around Control.
Tendon/connective movement-transmitting tissue family; historical wording foregrounds moving joined body parts.
Wound/localized injury-site family; historical name foregrounds a body part/region whose damage is high relative to the relevant injury standard.
Pre-magic monster category; historical name foregrounds a thing that attacks humans. This is not a live behavioral classifier.
Pre-magic deity category; historically named as a being/thing worshipped by people. Worship is not the live deity classifier.
Female-deity category built from the earlier Deity Old Name.
Pre-magic mana concept; historical wording foregrounds magic used by gods/deities, reflecting the old understanding before ordinary people could use magic.
Ordinary meditation practice; historical 'waking sleep' wording is fossilized and not a live conjunction of Awake and Sleep.
Human Kind; draft historical wording treats humans as knowing animals. This is not a live classifier.
Cat Kind; draft historical wording treats cats as low-size animals.
Water material Kind; draft historical wording foregrounds ordinary liquid matter rather than a live phase classifier.
Body Kind; draft historical wording foregrounds living matter. The fossilized name remains the body word after later state changes.
Hand Kind; draft historical wording now foregrounds a controlling/manipulating body part after Grab became compositional.
Sound Kind; draft historical wording foregrounds a thing known through hearing.
Canonical confidence Old Name built from Confidence + Unit. The sign names a typed measurement unit; it is not a separate primitive rune.
Canonical heat unit Old Name built from Heat + Unit. The sign names a typed measurement unit; it is not a separate primitive rune.
Canonical length unit Old Name built from Length + Unit. The sign names a typed measurement unit; it is not a separate primitive rune.
Canonical light unit Old Name built from Light + Unit. The sign names a typed measurement unit; it is not a separate primitive rune.
Canonical mass unit Old Name built from Mass + Unit. The sign names a typed measurement unit; it is not a separate primitive rune.

Canonical time/duration unit Old Name rebuilt from Extent + Unit after temporal Duration became the Event frame of Extent. The sign names a typed Time measurement unit; it is not a separate primitive rune.
Head family; historical wording foregrounds the body part associated with knowing/thought. Exact anatomy is frozen in the world concept, not recomputed from the etymology.
Face family; later anatomy vocabulary built from Head, foregrounding its visible/communicative surface.
Arm/manipulative-limb family; historical wording foregrounds a moving body part used in control/manipulation.
Leg/locomotor-limb family; historical wording foregrounds a body part used for movement.
Foot/distal locomotor part family; historical wording foregrounds movement and ground/contact use.
Finger/digit family; later vocabulary built from Hand and foregrounding a controlling/manipulating part of it.
Nose/olfactory-part family; historical wording foregrounds olfaction.
Tooth/dental family; historical wording foregrounds a hard body part used in eating.
Tongue/oral mobile-part family; historical wording foregrounds speech and eating.
Heart/circulatory-organ family; later vocabulary built from Blood and Organ and foregrounding blood movement.
Brain/cognition-associated organ family; later vocabulary built from Organ and foregrounding knowing/thought.
Hair/body-surface filament family; historical wording foregrounds a surface body part whose extent grows/changes.
Land/solid-terrain feature family; historical wording foregrounds solid matter occupying a geographic region.
Soil/earth material family; historical wording foregrounds matter associated with/supporting plant growth. Exact composition is world-defined.
Sand/granular mineral family; historical wording treats it as very small stone. Grain thresholds are frozen world classification, not live Low/Extent evaluation.
River/watercourse family; historical wording foregrounds moving water along a path.
Lake/inland-water family; historical wording contrasts a lower-extent water region with the later Sea word. Current membership is world-defined.
Sea/ocean family; historical wording foregrounds a high-extent water region. A particular lake/sea is not reclassified by current contextual size.
Mountain/high-relief landform family; historical wording foregrounds a large/high stone region while exact elevation/prominence belongs to world ontology.
Hill/moderate-relief landform family; later vocabulary built historically as a lower-extent Mountain word. Membership is frozen, not live comparison.
Island family; later vocabulary built from Land + In + Water. Exact surrounding-water topology belongs to world ontology.
Shore/coast family; historical wording foregrounds the contact boundary between Water and Land.
Forest/wooded-region family; historical wording foregrounds a region characterized by a group of Trees.
Sky/visible-above atmospheric region family; historical wording foregrounds high Air. Exact atmospheric extent is world-defined.
Cloud family; historical wording foregrounds Water suspended in Air. Ice-bearing and exotic clouds remain covered by the frozen world classifier where appropriate.
Rain/liquid-precipitation phenomenon family; historical wording foregrounds falling Water.
Ice/solid-water material family; historical wording foregrounds solid Water.
Snow/frozen-precipitation family; later vocabulary built from the Ice Old Name and Fall.
Wind/moving-air phenomenon family; historical wording foregrounds moving Air.

Storm/organized severe-weather family; historical wording foregrounds a large/extensive Wind phenomenon. Exact storm classification is world-defined and need not include wind in every exotic world case.
Cultivated field/land-parcel family; historical wording foregrounds a Region where food-producing life is grown.
Plant seed/propagule family; historical wording foregrounds a plant part associated with beginning new Life.
Leaf/foliar plant-part family; historical wording foregrounds a surface-associated plant part.
Fruit/seed-bearing plant-structure family; historical wording foregrounds an edible/useful plant part. Botanical membership is world-defined, not recomputed from edibility.
Cultivated-plant/crop family; historical wording foregrounds plants deliberately controlled/managed by a civilization.
Grain/edible harvested seed family; later vocabulary built from the Seed and Food Old Names.
Milk/lactation-derived nutritive liquid family; historical wording foregrounds food matter associated with female animals. Exact producers/composition are world-defined.
Animal egg/reproductive-stage family; historical wording foregrounds a thing associated with beginning animal Life.
Salt/mineral family; historical wording treats it as a strongly taste-salient stone/mineral. Exact chemistry is world-defined.
Clay/plastic fine-earth material family; historical wording foregrounds soil-like matter that readily changes Form.
Cloth/textile material family; historical wording foregrounds joined/interworked small matter/fibers.
Hide/leather material family; later vocabulary built from the Skin Old Name. Processing state and source species are world-defined.
Glass/vitreous material family; historical wording foregrounds sand-like matter transformed with heat. Exact recipes are world-defined.
Fuel/energy-supplying material family; historical wording foregrounds matter that preserves/sustains Fire. Exact energy pathways belong to world/execution ontology.
Knife/small hand-blade family; later vocabulary built historically as a lower-length Blade.
Axe/hewing-tool family; historical wording foregrounds a cutting tool strongly associated with Wood.
Saw family; historical wording foregrounds repeated cutting action.
Cooking-vessel family; historical wording foregrounds a Container used with Heat.
Needle/sewing-tool family; historical wording foregrounds a sharp tool used to bring material into Joined states.
Wheel family; historical wording foregrounds a rotating part. Exact wheel geometry is world-defined.
Wheeled land-transport vehicle family; later vocabulary built from Wheel and movement.
Plow/soil-working tool family; historical wording foregrounds changing Soil with a Tool.
Loom/textile-forming tool family; historical wording foregrounds bringing Textile into existence with a Tool.
High-heat chamber/furnace/kiln family; historical wording foregrounds a high-Heat enclosure/container.
Anvil/forming-support tool family; historical wording foregrounds a hard Tool used while changing Metal.
Sail family; later vocabulary built as a Wind-associated Part of a Boat.
Oar/paddle propulsion-tool family; historical wording foregrounds a Tool used to move a Boat.
Anchor/station-keeping object family; historical wording foregrounds preventing Boat movement.
Port/harbor transport-site family; historical wording foregrounds a Region/site that has or receives Boats. Natural harbor geography is separate.
Constructed building/structure family; historical wording foregrounds a joined enclosure/thing.
Roof family; later vocabulary foregrounds a Building part that prevents Rain/weather entry.
Room/interior-space feature family; historical wording foregrounds a Region in a Building.
Floor family; historical wording foregrounds a Building surface/part used for movement.
Workshop/craft-space family; historical wording foregrounds a Building or space for Tool use.
Mill/material-processing facility family; historical wording foregrounds a Building used to change/process Grain.
Fortification/defensive-work family; historical wording foregrounds a constructed structure intended to prevent or resist Attack.

Soldier/military-service role family; historical wording foregrounds a human obligated to perform organized attack/combat service. Defense-only and noncombat military roles remain covered by the frozen world classifier where appropriate.
Army/organized military-group family; later vocabulary built from Soldier + Group.
Armor/worn protective-equipment family; historical wording foregrounds Clothing intended to prevent/resist Attack.
Shield/portable defensive-tool family; historical wording foregrounds a Tool used to prevent/resist Attack.
Spear/polearm family; historical wording foregrounds a long sharp Weapon. Exact geometry and intended use belong to world ontology.
Bow/projectile-launching ranged-weapon family; historical wording foregrounds attacking at Distance with a Weapon. The frozen classifier distinguishes bows from other ranged weapons.
Arrow/projectile-ammunition family; historical wording foregrounds a sharp moving attack-thing. Exact association with bows and projectile construction belongs to world ontology.
Prison/detention institution or facility family; historical wording foregrounds a Building that prevents/restricts human movement. Exact legal and physical confinement rules are world-defined.
Prisoner/detainee status-role family; later vocabulary built from Prison + Human. A prisoner can remain a Prisoner while temporarily outside a prison facility.
Judge/adjudicating-authority role family; historical wording foregrounds a human holding Authority in a Court.
Polity/state political-community family; historical wording foregrounds a human Group organized by Law and recognized Authority. Exact territory, sovereignty, and membership belong to world ontology.
Government/governing-institution family; later vocabulary foregrounds a Group exercising Authority for a Polity.
Citizen/polity-member status-role family; historical wording foregrounds a Human who is a Member of a Polity. Exact citizenship rights, duties, and eligibility are world-defined.
Temple/religious-facility family; historical wording foregrounds a Building associated with Worship.
Shrine/devotional-focus family; historical wording foregrounds a Thing/Tool used in Worship. Exact sacred status and scale are world-defined.
Priest/religious-officiant role family; historical wording foregrounds a Human with recognized Authority in worship/ritual practice.
Ritual/ceremony event category; historical wording foregrounds a rule-governed or prescribed sequence. Exact event classification is world-defined.
Prayer event category; historical wording foregrounds saying/address within worship. Silent/nonverbal prayer may still satisfy the frozen world classifier.
Sacrifice/offering event category; historical wording foregrounds transfer/relinquishment in a worship context. Destruction, dedication, symbolism, and recipients are world-defined.
Dance event category; historical wording foregrounds patterned/repeated movement. Exact styles and non-repetitive dances remain world-classified.
Performance/presentation event category; historical wording foregrounds an event intended to be sensed/observed by an audience.
Game/sport play-event category; historical wording foregrounds rule-governed attempts/goals. Specific games and rulesets remain world vocabulary.
Festival/feast communal-celebration event category; historical wording foregrounds group happiness and eating. Neither feature is a live requirement.
Story/tale narrative Information category; historical wording foregrounds a sequence of Words. Oral, visual, or otherwise encoded stories remain world-classified.
Music/composition Information category; historical wording foregrounds an ordered sequence intended for hearing. Actual performance and sound are distinct.
Song/vocal-musical composition Information category; later vocabulary built from Say + Music. A singing performance is an Event, not the composition itself.
Musical-instrument artifact family; later vocabulary built from Music + Tool.
Persistent visual image/painting artifact family; historical wording foregrounds a visually sensed Record.
Sculpture/three-dimensional artwork artifact family; historical wording foregrounds Form carried by a persistent Record/artifact.
Calendar-day interval family; historical wording foregrounds one waking/sleeping temporal extent. Exact day boundaries and duration are world/calendar-defined.
Night interval family; historical wording foregrounds the sleeping interval. Exact astronomical/light/cultural boundaries are world-defined.
Season interval family; historical wording foregrounds an extent associated with changing heat/climate. Worlds may classify seasons by other cycles.
Year interval family; later historical vocabulary built from a repeating Season. Exact astronomical/civil year definition is world-defined.
Month/calendar-period interval family; historical wording foregrounds a subdivision of a Year. A world need not have months.
Calendar-date Information category; historical wording foregrounds a named coordinate/entry in a Calendar. Exact calendar fields and mapping to time are world-defined.
